notes: Read all 232 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. This is a pure, non-visual React data hook (eight memoized cost-analysis datasets from ChargingSession[] + pricing inputs). There is NO DOM, JSX, Recharts, Leaflet, browser-only behavior, or old web @/components/ui import to adapt — `react`'s `useMemo` is the only runtime dependency and behaves identically under React Native — so every computation, state name, API field name (cost_decimal, total_energy_added_wh, started_at, ended_at, charger_type, peak_power_w, start_place, start_odometer_m, end_odometer_m), and unit-handling expression is ported verbatim.
L1 `import { useMemo } from 'react'` -> identical native `import {useMemo} from 'react'` (react is shared; useMemo is RN-compatible).

L2 `import type { ChargingSession } from '@/api/types'` -> native parity api/types barrel `../../../../api/types` (cost-analysis -> components -> charging -> features -> web-parity, then /api/types; same depth as the sibling charging-list/helpers.ts port). The native ChargingSession interface carries every field this hook reads.

L3 `import { distanceAddedM, durationMinutes } from '../charging-curve/helpers'` -> inlined native-safe verbatim ports (no native charging-curve/helpers port exists yet). distanceAddedM: positive end-minus-start odometer delta in meters, else null when an endpoint is null. durationMinutes: Math.round((end-start)/60000) whole minutes, 0 for missing/invalid/non-positive. Both byte-for-byte identical to web charging-curve/helpers.ts L18-30.

L4 `import { formatDateShort } from '@/lib/dateFormat'` -> inlined native-safe port of the web helper's no-options path (the hook only ever calls formatDateShort(s.started_at), single arg): nullish/invalid -> universal '—' placeholder, otherwise Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric'}).format(d) — identical output to the web `d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric'})`, matching the established native lib/format.ts + charging-list/helpers.ts convention.

L5 `import { CHART_COLORS, CHARGER_COLORS } from '@/lib/colors'` -> inlined verbatim. CHART_COLORS: the bare web export resolves to CHART_COLORS_CB_SAFE (the color-blind-safe Okabe-Ito palette), ported as the 8-entry array so the only consumed index CHART_COLORS[4] === '#56B4E9' is preserved. CHARGER_COLORS: the Record ported verbatim (internal keys + the display-name keys this hook looks up via the category names from categorizeCharger).

L6 `import { KWH_PER_GALLON, CO2_PER_GAL_KG, KG_CO2_PER_TREE_YEAR } from './constants'` -> imported from the ALREADY-PORTED native ./constants module in this same directory (constants.ts, byte-for-byte identical to web), exactly mirroring the web import. No duplication; most faithful to web L6.

L7 `import { categorizeCharger, gasEquivalentCost } from './helpers'` -> inlined native-safe verbatim ports (no native cost-analysis/helpers port exists yet). categorizeCharger: charger_type 'tesla'/'supercharger' -> 'Supercharger'; peak_power_w>22000 -> 'Public DC'; start_place 'work'/'office' -> 'Work / L2'; else 'Home'. gasEquivalentCost: (energyKwh/KWH_PER_GALLON)*mpg/mpg*gasPrice (uses the ./constants KWH_PER_GALLON imported at L6). Identical to web helpers.ts L4-21.

L8 `import { convertEnergyFromSI } from '@/lib/unitConversion'` -> inlined verbatim with `type EnergyUnitPref = 'Wh' | 'kWh'`: 'Wh' -> wh, 'kWh' -> wh/1000 (web unitConversion.ts L198-205). Only the 'kWh' branch is exercised here. Energy is read as SI watt-hours from the API and converted at this display/aggregation boundary, consistent with the SI-canonical contract — no new unit-suffixed field is introduced.

L9-12 `import type { CoreStats, MonthlyBucket, ChargerTypeData, HourBucket, TouInsights, GasComparison, LifetimeMetrics } from './types'` -> all seven interfaces reproduced locally as byte-for-byte verbatim ports (no native ./types port exists yet; the sibling LifetimeSummary.tsx port did the same for CoreStats/LifetimeMetrics). CoreStats/MonthlyBucket/ChargerTypeData/HourBucket/TouInsights/GasComparison/LifetimeMetrics are exported so the result contract is identical and re-usable. These are computed metrics (totalDistanceM already SI meters), not new DB/struct fields, so no SI unit-suffix rule applies.

L14-21 `interface UseCostAnalysisDataParams { sessions: ChargingSession[]|undefined; gasPrice; mpg; electricityRate; toDistanceDisplay: (km)=>number; isMiles }` -> ported verbatim (the toDistanceDisplay callback is injected by the caller exactly as on web; this hook does no display-unit conversion of distance itself beyond calling it).

L23-32 `interface UseCostAnalysisDataResult { coreStats; monthlyData; costPerKwhTrend: {date;costPerKwh}[]; chargerTypeData; hourlyData; touInsights; gasComparison; lifetimeMetrics }` -> ported verbatim.
L34-41 hook signature `export function useCostAnalysisData({sessions,gasPrice,mpg,electricityRate,toDistanceDisplay,isMiles})` -> identical destructured params + return type.

L42-70 coreStats useMemo -> ported verbatim: null when no sessions; totalCost = sum(cost_decimal??0); totalEnergy = convertEnergyFromSI(sum(total_energy_added_wh),'kWh'); avgCostPerKwh; totalDuration = sum(durationMinutes); totalDistanceM = sum(distanceAddedM??0); distVal = toDistanceDisplay(totalDistanceM/1609.344); costPerDist; gallonsEquiv = totalEnergy/KWH_PER_GALLON; gasCost; savings; savingsPercent; co2SavedKg = gallonsEquiv*CO2_PER_GAL_KG; treeEquiv = co2SavedKg/KG_CO2_PER_TREE_YEAR; count. Same deps [sessions, gasPrice, toDistanceDisplay].

L72-98 monthlyData useMemo -> ported verbatim: buckets keyed `${year}-${MM}` (getFullYear/getMonth+1 padStart 2); accumulate cost/energy/sessions; sort by month localeCompare; per month energyKwh=convertEnergyFromSI(v.energy,'kWh'), ge=gasEquivalentCost(energyKwh,mpg,gasPrice), avgCostPerKwh, gasEquiv=ge, savings=ge-cost. Deps [sessions, gasPrice, mpg].

L100-112 costPerKwhTrend useMemo -> ported verbatim: filter cost_decimal!=null && total_energy_added_wh>0; sort ascending by started_at time; map to {date: formatDateShort(started_at), costPerKwh: (cost_decimal??0)/(total_energy_added_wh/1000)}. Deps [sessions].

L114-133 chargerTypeData useMemo -> ported verbatim: group by categorizeCharger(s); accumulate cost/energy/sessions; map to {name, cost, energy: convertEnergyFromSI(v.energy,'kWh'), sessions, color: CHARGER_COLORS[name] ?? CHART_COLORS[4]}; sort desc by cost. Deps [sessions].

L135-156 hourlyData useMemo -> ported verbatim: seed buckets 0..23 with {sessions,totalCost,totalEnergy}; bucket by new Date(started_at).getHours(); accumulate; map to {hour, label: `${HH}:00`, sessions, avgCost: totalCost/sessions when >0, totalEnergy: convertEnergyFromSI(v.totalEnergy,'kWh')}; sort asc by hour. Deps [sessions].

L158-173 touInsights useMemo -> ported verbatim: null when no hourly rows or none with sessions; cheapest/priciest by avgCost asc/desc, busiest by sessions desc (each via [...withSessions].sort(...)[0]); offPeakCount = sessions where hour>=22||hour<6; offPeakPct = offPeakCount/sessions.length*100. Deps [hourlyData, sessions].

L175-200 gasComparison useMemo -> ported verbatim: null when !coreStats; distMiles = toDistanceDisplay(totalDistanceM/1609.344); gallonsNeeded = isMiles ? distMiles/mpg : toDistanceDisplay(totalDistanceM/1609.344)/mpg; gasCostCalc; evCostCalc = totalEnergy*electricityRate; monthlySavings = monthlyData.length>0 ? (gasCostCalc-evCostCalc)/Math.max(monthlyData.length,1):0; yearlySavings = *12; return {gasCost,evCost,actualCost,savings,monthlySavings,yearlySavings,costPerMileGas,costPerMileEV}. Deps [coreStats, gasPrice, mpg, electricityRate, isMiles, toDistanceDisplay, monthlyData.length].

L202-226 lifetimeMetrics useMemo -> ported verbatim: null when no sessions or !coreStats; avgSessionCost/avgSessionEnergy/avgDuration from coreStats over count; freeCount/freeEnergy over sessions with !cost_decimal||===0; maxSessionCost = Math.max(...cost_decimal??0); minSessionCost = Math.min(...positive cost_decimal!, 0). Deps [sessions, coreStats]. The non-null assertion cost_decimal! is preserved (guarded by the >0 filter).
L228-232 return object -> ported verbatim: {coreStats, monthlyData, costPerKwhTrend, chargerTypeData, hourlyData, touInsights, gasComparison, lifetimeMetrics}.

Native reductions are import-only and behavior-preserving: ChargingSession from native api/types; constants from the existing native ./constants; small pure lib/sibling helpers (distanceAddedM, durationMinutes, formatDateShort, CHART_COLORS, CHARGER_COLORS, convertEnergyFromSI, categorizeCharger, gasEquivalentCost) and the seven ./types interfaces inlined as native-safe verbatim ports (their native modules are not yet ported), exactly matching the established self-contained single-file convention of the sibling charging-list/helpers.ts. No DOM-only module, browser HTML element, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI component is imported. No new SI unit-suffixed field is introduced; SI Wh is converted to kWh only at this aggregation/display boundary.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` exit 0 (no errors); `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all suites passed. The new hook module is not imported by any existing Jest suite and does not affect them; no co-located test exists for sibling cost-analysis ports (LifetimeSummary/constants), so none was added.
